The texture of the print lacks the micro-fiber detail seen in the white fabric, suggesting a potential generative smoothing or texture mapping issue.

The black object at the very top center is ambiguous. It resembles a tag or strap end but lacks clear structural connection or logical thickness. It appears to float slightly or merge indistinctly with the background/binding, which is a common AI artifact in small, thin details.
